core_categories: Medical Devices; Urology; Continence Care; Wound Care; Skin Care
specialty_focus: Clinisupplies is a UK-based manufacturer and marketer of medical devices for primary and secondary healthcare, specializing in urology, bladder and bowel management, and wound and skin care products. It supplies the UK NHS and delivers directly to patients' homes, and also operates as a dispensing appliance contractor through its Clinidirect service.
